message.content:
This is a set of reusable gel ice packs for coolers. CBP rulings on similar reusable ice packs (gel-filled, flexible plastic or laminated) have generally classified them in 3924.90 (other household articles of plastics) or in 3926.90. For sets with a nylon, aluminum and mylar laminate exterior, the plastic components give the product its essential character. Some rulings placed these in 3924.90.5650, "Other household articles... other."

The 3924.90 subheading covers "Tableware, kitchenware, other household articles and hygienic or toilet articles, of plastics: Other." In the HTSUS, 3924.90.56 is "Other" and 3924.90.5650 is the statistical suffix for "Other."

A different possibility is 3926.90.99 for other articles of plastic. However, ice packs for lunch bags and coolers are household articles, so 3924.90.5650 fits better.

{"hts_code": "3924.90.5650", "reason": "Reusable flexible gel-filled ice packs with a laminated plastic exterior, used in household coolers and lunch bags, are classified as other household articles of plastics."}
